questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) A telephone dealer decides to import 200 smart phones at a total cost of 8 million FCFA. She pays 40% of the amount as taxes.

Find:

(a) the total amount spent on taxes.
(b) her total expenditure on the phones
questions.corrige_markdown:
The taxes are paid on top of the cost of the phones, so total expenditure = cost of the phones + taxes $=8\,000\,000+3\,200\,000=11\,200\,000$ FCFA.

**Total expenditure $=11\,200\,000$ FCFA.**

Cost of one phone $=\dfrac{11\,200\,000}{200}=56\,000$ FCFA.

**Cost of a phone $=56\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
If she makes a profit of 15% on each phone,

Find

(d) the profit made on each phone
questions.corrige_markdown:
Profit per phone $=15\%$ of $56\,000=\dfrac{15}{100}\times56\,000=8\,400$ FCFA.

**Profit on each phone $=8\,400$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (e) the total selling price of the phones *[10 marks for (i)]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Selling price of one phone $=56\,000+8\,400=64\,400$ FCFA.

Total selling price $=200\times64\,400=12\,880\,000$ FCFA.

(Check: $11\,200\,000\times1.15=12\,880\,000$.)

**Total selling price $=12\,880\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
(ii) Solve the simultaneous equations

$2p-3q=12$

$3p+q=7$ *[5 marks for (ii)]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Label: (1) $2p-3q=12$ and (2) $3p+q=7$.

Multiply (2) by $3$: (3) $9p+3q=21$.

Add (1) and (3): $11p=33\Rightarrow p=3$.

Substitute in (2): $9+q=7\Rightarrow q=-2$.

Check in (1): $2(3)-3(-2)=6+6=12$. Correct.

**$p=3$ and $q=-2$.**
